{{Quote|For years ''Nothoiin'' was the centre of a very profitable black market operation!|[[Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo/Legends|Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo]]|<ref name="The Runaway Ride" />}}
'''Nothoiin''' was the [[Nothoiin (species)/Legends|Nothoiin]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], on the [[Nothoiin Corridor]] and [[Nothoiin Route]]. It was a planet with limited development beyond the [[Ur-diamond/Legends|ur-diamond]] mining operations conducted on its crystal [[Moon/Legends|moon]]. In the years leading up to and following the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Nothoiin's affairs were dominated by a crushing fifty-year-long drought leading to rampant, uncontrollable wildfires.<ref name="GG" />
